title: Cell death victim named: [Final C Edition]
article: The man who died early Friday while in custody of the Chilliwack RCMP has been identified as Christopher David Doyle of Chilliwack.
An RCMP press release said the 45-year-old was arrested without incident for allegedly being drunk in public about 8:30 p.m. Thursday evening.

Shortly after midnight Friday, staff at the Chilliwack RCMP detachment noticed Doyle was not breathing. Officers called an ambulance and attempted to revive him, but he was pronounced dead at Chilliwack General Hospital The RCMP and the B.C. Coroner Service are investigating the incident.
